statement: Large US cloud providers grew server procurement 11.6% quarter-over-quarter in 2Q26 but are forecast to add only 1.7% quarter-over-quarter in 3Q26, a sharp deceleration.
why: Hyperscaler procurement is the largest single pull on AI server and accelerator demand, so a step down from double-digit to low-single-digit sequential growth signals the buying pace is cooling.

impact.mechanism: Slower sequential procurement by the largest cloud buyers reduces the near-term order flow that feeds accelerator and AI-server shipments.

evidence.excerpt: Large US cloud providers increased procurement by '11.6% quarter-over-quarter' in 2Q26.
large cloud provider procurement anticipated to rise only '1.7% quarter-over-quarter'

confidence.basis: Single secondary research house; underlying data sits behind a paid subscription and was not independently verified.
